title: The Promise of Three Lives

visual_scene: A mystical ancient Chinese cultivation mountain garden bathed in soft spring moonlight, a single ancient cherry blossom tree in full bloom with petals falling slowly through the air like snow. Young male cultivator in simple grey robes kneeling before a beautiful young woman in flowing pale pink Hanfu embroidered with silver flowers, holding out a single white flower toward her with gentle eyes full of devotion, cherry blossom petals caught in their hair and clothing. She reaches out slowly with a trembling hand, tears of joy forming, a soft warm smile breaking across her face as moonlight illuminates them both. Scene dissolves into autumn — a desolate mountain temple courtyard drenched in heavy rain, bare dark tree branches, and a grave marker made of white stone covered in fallen red leaves. The same woman now wearing elegant flowing white mourning robes standing perfectly still before the grave, rain streaming down her face mixing with tears, her expression hollow and ancient, holding a single wilted flower, the weight of centuries of waiting visible in her eyes. Scene dissolves to spring — a misty ancient stone bridge arching over a still koi pond full of pink lotus flowers, fireflies glowing softly in the dawn mist. The same two people standing on opposite ends of the bridge in flowing cultivation robes, looking at each other with recognition across lifetimes, slowly extending their hands toward each other across the bridge as a single cherry blossom petal falls between their outstretched fingers in ultra slow motion. Ancient Chinese cultivation world, soft ethereal atmosphere, alternating seasons, ultra slow motion, cinematic.
